actual: Prior run bebfe230 429 RATE_LIMITED failures on audit_read, issue_reinstall, incarnation_history and probe_process are reviewed as resolved under D-078. Harness Retry-After retries landed in 286eb57b44c2e783257767918680a0e1f097f106 (#210). Run 35e542f8 probe_process and rate_limit_review stay in prior_checks and stop blocking on that behaviour evidence. rescored_follow_up_3.reasoning: D-078 re-score of follow-up 3 run 60a7102e. The raw rate_limit_review stayed blocked with http_429 2 and those two paths; that count and the samples stay in prior_checks. Both samples are limiter class browser. The saved samples do not include a Retry-After header value, so none is invented here. On that run callHeaders retried each 429 with the same Idempotency-Key using the Retry-After header (1-30s; the 1s default applies only when the header is absent). The product emits Retry-After on RATE_LIMITED. audit_read, issue_reinstall and incarnation_history passed, which is the evidence those retried requests succeeded inside the window. The join-phase rate_limit_review on that run recorded http_429 0. Under D-078 that is the limiter working. A 429 without Retry-After, a retry that is still 429, a non-browser class on this browser-table review, or any join-phase 429 remains a finding. The zero-count resolution criterion is withdrawn.
